answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the terrace of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, reduced by each unverified claim, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The raven lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the nectar is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
